title: Serve the EUR battle relative directory
changes: Add the independent 103-entry battle relative directory to the static OBJ resource, keeping its opaque header byte and all offsets while leaving target interpretation and original selection logic in the guest.
validation: Wine e149-battle-directory-wine-951r5cd9 preserves the E148 projection and other resources, verifies all 210 poisoned source bytes and mixed-width boundaries, and compares six original-reader selector cases including low-16-bit truncation and out-of-range inputs. One ordinary selector-62 interpreter/native-dispatch raw/managed pair matches complete state and clock, with five typed bytes and no raw source reads per arm.
Wine e149-battle-directory-cli-wine-602qybdq passes production CLI create, no-write reuse, verification and one-frame startup; 102 other resource files match E148.
limitations: other ordinary selectors, target payload classification, per-read native attribution, frontend save/load, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurement.
